item.title: Hi, I'm James
item.description:
I’m a software engineering leader building with AI. I’ve spent the last decade working on data and AI products. Currently, I’m doing some contract work building agentic systems.

Life Outside of Work

I live in Baltimore with my wife Lauren, our two-year-old son Frankie, our six-month-old daughter Margaux, and our dog Obi. Our days are wonderfully full.

In the hour or so per day I have to myself, I’m usually reading, exercising, or working on a house project. I’m a huge fantasy fan (Brandon Sanderson is my favorite author). I’m currently working my way through Terry Pratchett’s Discworld series.
